faq.a1: Yes! AlbionKit is 100% free and free to use with no paywalls. All features are available to everyone at no cost. We accept voluntary donations to help cover server costs and development time, but nothing is locked behind a paywall.
faq.q2: Is it safe? Will I get banned?
faq.a2: AlbionKit is completely safe. We do not inspect game memory, inject code, or automate actions. We strictly follow SBI's Terms of Service. All market data is crowdsourced via the approved Albion Data Project.
faq.q3: How accurate is the market data?
faq.a3: Prices are updated by real players using the Albion Data Client. In major cities like Lymhurst and Fort Sterling, data is typically just minutes old. Less popular items may have older data.
faq.q4: Can I contribute to the project?
faq.a4: Absolutely! AlbionKit is community driven and welcomes feedback. You can help with translations, report bugs, suggest features, or even submit code. Check out our GitHub repository to get started.
faq.q5: Do you have a mobile app?
faq.a5: AlbionKit is a Progressive Web App (PWA). You can install it directly on your phone or tablet for a native-like experience without needing an app store.

AboutPage.title: About AlbionKit
AboutPage.description: AlbionKit is built by a solo developer for the Albion Online community. Free tools, no paywalls, no nonsense.
AboutPage.heroSubtitle: I build tools because I use them. No team, no roadmap, no hidden agenda. Just free utilities for the community.
AboutPage.missionP1: AlbionKit started as a personal toolkit - market flippers, kill feeds, guild trackers - built because I was tired of juggling browser tabs, Discord bots, and broken spreadsheets.
AboutPage.missionP2: Today it's grown into a comprehensive suite, but the spirit is the same: build what I wish existed, and share it freely.
AboutPage.missionP3: No premium tiers, no paywalls, no tracking. Just tools powered by the incredible Albion Data Project.
AboutPage.marketFlipperDesc: Instantly find profitable trade routes between the Royal Cities and the Black Market. Factor in fast travel, taxes, and daily volume to guarantee silver profits.
AboutPage.playerIntelDesc: Search for any player to view their combat statistics, recent activity, and gear analysis.
AboutPage.killFeedDesc: Monitor real-time PvP combat across all servers. See exactly who is dying, where, and what gear they dropped.
AboutPage.metaBuildsDesc: Discover the most popular loadouts used by top players in Corrupted Dungeons, Hellgates, and ZvZ battles.
AboutPage.guildManagementDesc: Track Bandit Assaults, calculate faction point efficiency, and maximize your returns on heart transports.
AboutPage.globalSupportDesc: Fully localized in 9 languages, ensuring the global Albion community can trade and fight without language barriers.
AboutPage.dataSourcesDesc: We rely heavily on the Albion Data Project. If you find our tools useful, please consider installing the client to help keep prices updated for everyone!
AboutPage.developerIntro: Hey, I'm Cosmic  -  a fullstack developer who fell into Albion Online in 2024 and never really left. What started as a distraction from spreadsheets turned into a full-blown obsession with building tools that make the game more accessible for everyone.
AboutPage.whyStartedP1: Albion Online throws a lot at you. Market prices swing wildly, Bandit Assaults pop up without warning, and tracking your PvP stats across three regions is a nightmare. I kept juggling browser tabs, Discord bots, and half-broken spreadsheets, and I thought: there has to be a better way.
AboutPage.whyStartedP2: So I built one. AlbionKit started as a personal toolkit  -  market flippers, kill feeds, guild trackers  -  and slowly grew into what you see today. Every feature is something I actually wanted while playing.
AboutPage.expectP1: This isn't a corporate product with a roadmap hidden behind a login wall. It's a passion project that evolves every week. New tools, better data, more regions, and occasional experiments that may or may not survive the week.
AboutPage.expectP2: Expect honesty. If something breaks, I'll say it. If an API is flaky, I'll work around it. If you have a feature idea, I'll actually read it.
AboutPage.value1Desc: No hidden paywalls, no dark patterns. The tools are free because they should be.
AboutPage.value2Desc: Fast load times, smart caching, and minimal bloat. If a page takes more than 2 seconds to load, I consider it a bug.
AboutPage.value3Desc: Built for players, shaped by players. Every piece of feedback goes into the backlog and many features come directly from Discord suggestions.
AboutPage.donateDesc: Hosting, APIs, and domain costs add up. If AlbionKit saves you silver, time, or frustration, consider buying me a coffee. Every bit helps keep the project free and running.
AboutPage.contactDesc: Found a bug? Have a feature idea? Want to collaborate? Reach out through the bot suggest command, GitHub issues, or Discord.

CookiePolicy.title: Cookie Policy
CookiePolicy.description: We use cookies to improve your experience, analyze site traffic, and personalize content. This policy explains what cookies are and how we use them.

whatAreCookies.title: 1. What Are Cookies
whatAreCookies.content: Cookies are small pieces of text sent by your web browser by a website you visit. A cookie file is stored in your web browser and allows the Service or a third-party to recognize you and make your next visit easier and the Service more useful to you. Cookies can be "persistent" or "session" cookies.

howWeUse.title: 2. How We Use Cookies
howWeUse.intro: When you use and access the Service, we may place a number of cookies files in your web browser. We use cookies for the following purposes:

essential.title: Essential Cookies
essential.description: These are necessary for the website to function properly. They enable core functionality such as security, network management, and accessibility. You cannot disable these.

analytics.title: Analytics Cookies
analytics.description: We use these to understand how visitors interact with our website, helping us improve the user experience. These collect information anonymously.

functionality.title: Functionality Cookies
functionality.description: These allow us to remember choices you make (such as your preferred server region or language) to provide a more personalized experience.

choices.title: 3. Your Choices
choices.content: If you'd like to delete cookies or instruct your web browser to delete or refuse cookies, please visit the help pages of your web browser. Please note, however, that if you delete cookies or refuse to accept them, you might not be able to use all of the features we offer, you may not be able to store your preferences, and some of our pages might not display properly.

GatheringRoutes.title: Gathering Routes Guide
GatheringRoutes.description: Find the best gathering routes and zones in Albion Online
GatheringRoutes.heroSubtitle: Best zones and biomes for efficient resource gathering
GatheringRoutes.introText: Gathering is the foundation of Albion's player-driven economy. Knowing where to find the right resources, which zones to avoid, and how to optimize your route can double your silver per hour. This guide covers every biome, zone type, and strategy you need.
GatheringRoutes.biomesSubtitle: Each royal city has unique refining bonuses and resource distributions
GatheringRoutes.gearCaption: Specialized gathering gear significantly increases your yield and speed
GatheringRoutes.zonesSubtitle: Choose the right zone for your risk tolerance and gear level
GatheringRoutes.tipsSubtitle: Survive and profit in the open world

hotspots.title: Use Hotspots
hotspots.desc: Hotspots have higher resource density and enchanted node chances. Check the map for hotspot indicators before choosing your route.

gear.title: Wear Gathering Gear
gear.desc: Gathering sets provide yield bonuses and built-in escape abilities. A proper set can increase your income by 30-50%.

mounts.title: Choose the Right Mount
mounts.desc: Use oxen for carry capacity in safe zones, swiftclaws for escaping in dangerous zones. Always have an escape plan.

safety.title: Safety First
safety.desc: Never carry more than you can afford to lose. Bank regularly, watch the minimap, and avoid high-traffic areas during peak hours.

SilverFarming.title: Daily Silver Farming Guide
SilverFarming.description: Learn the best daily silver farming methods in Albion Online
SilverFarming.heroSubtitle: Best methods to make silver in Albion Online 2026
SilverFarming.introText: Silver is the backbone of Albion Online's economy. Whether you're a new player looking for safe methods or an experienced veteran chasing high-risk rewards, this guide covers the most effective silver farming methods available in 2026.
SilverFarming.methodsSubtitle: The most profitable activities ranked by silver per hour
SilverFarming.marketCaption: Understanding market prices is key to profitable trading and flipping

depths.title: The Depths
depths.desc: Safe instanced dungeons with no gear loss. Perfect for consistent silver without PvP risk.

hearts.title: Faction Heart Transport
hearts.desc: Transport faction hearts between cities for faction points and silver. One of the best methods for new players.

gathering.title: T5-T6 Gathering
gathering.desc: Gather resources in safe zones and sell them on the market. Steady income with no risk.

corrupted.title: Corrupted Dungeons
corrupted.desc: Solo PvP dungeons with forced invasions. High risk but rewarding for skilled players.

focusCrafting.title: Focus Crafting
focusCrafting.desc: Use daily focus to craft items with material return bonuses. Passive income that scales with specialization.

marketFlipping.title: Market Flipping
marketFlipping.desc: Buy low, sell high across cities or the black market. Requires capital but scales infinitely.

focus.title: Focus is Silver
focus.desc: Never let your daily focus pool go to waste. 10,000 focus can be worth 1-3M silver when used efficiently on crafting or refining.

premium.title: Premium Pays for Itself
premium.desc: Premium provides 10k daily focus, 50% fame bonus, and reduced market taxes. The island and focus income alone cover its cost.

island.title: Island First
island.desc: Buy a Tier 1 island as soon as possible. The 20k silver first-time discount is the best deal in the game.

specialization.title: Specialize Early
specialization.desc: Pick one crafting or gathering line and go deep. Specialization cuts focus costs and increases yields exponentially.
